name: Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did St. Catherine Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana hospitals; Community Hospital has the most, 2,526. About 6.9 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did St. Mary Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana hospitals; Community Hospital has the most, 2,526. About 7.1 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Community Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana hospital reports more; St. Mary Medical Center is next at 1,275. About 6.2 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: What percent of St. Catherine Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana hospitals; St. Mary Medical Center runs highest, 67 percent. Traditional Medicare was 20 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 26 percent.

questions.q: What percent of St. Mary Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?

questions.q: What percent of St. Catherine Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?

questions.q: What percent of St. Mary Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?

questions.q: What percent of Community Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana hospitals; St. Catherine Hospital runs highest, 39 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 2 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 16 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at St. Catherine Hospital in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana hospital kept patients longer; Community Hospital is next at 5.1 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Community Foundation of Northwest Indiana run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Indiana. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.
